run: set -eux; glab_version=1.125.0; case "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" in amd64) glab_sha256=cef937bc144078826c50f8dfa32fcd899a9a3e79dbffb0c8ed6e609a07b2ea55 ;; arm64) glab_sha256=2fdfeb0080ed33631176e9dc419ac10d52f1bda57b66238497f9c1f677a3f88f ;; *) echo "unsupported glab architecture: $(dpkg --print-architecture)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; glab_deb="/tmp/glab_${glab_version}_linux_$(dpkg --print-architecture).deb"; curl -fsSL "https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/releases/v${glab_version}/downloads/glab_${glab_version}_linux_$(dpkg --print-architecture).deb" -o "$glab_deb"; echo "$glab_sha256  $glab_deb" | sha256sum -c; dpkg -i "$glab_deb"; rm -f "$glab_deb"; glab --version | grep -F "glab $glab_version"
